summary: The shape of content that has not arrived. Always hidden from assistive technology — the caller owns the announcement.
useWhen: a region will be replaced by content whose shape is known in advance
the layout would otherwise jump when the content lands
several regions load independently and a single page spinner would hide that

useInstead.when: the shape of what is coming is not known
useInstead.why: a skeleton that does not match what replaces it is a worse promise than no promise

useInstead.when: the region is empty because there is nothing to show
useInstead.why: a skeleton that never resolves is how an empty list looks like a broken one

text.note: height comes from the line box, so the block occupies what the real paragraph will. With `lines`, the last is drawn short because real paragraphs end mid-measure

circle.use: an avatar or an icon slot

rect.use: a card, a thumbnail, a chart

requires: `aria-busy="true"` on the region being replaced, set by the CALLER — this component cannot do it, because only the caller knows where the region starts and ends
notes: every skeleton is aria-hidden with no opt-out: a screen reader cannot use a picture of content, and announcing it puts a stream of empty boxes between the user and what they asked for
prefers-reduced-motion stops the pulse outright, unlike Spinner and ProgressBar — a skeleton conveys nothing a static block does not, so there is no signal to preserve

antiPatterns.dont: <Skeleton /> inside a region with no aria-busy
antiPatterns.why: the skeleton is hidden, so without aria-busy a screen-reader user is told nothing at all — the region simply reads as empty

antiPatterns.dont: a skeleton whose shape does not match the content that replaces it
antiPatterns.do: match the line count and block sizes to the real thing
antiPatterns.why: the entire benefit is that the layout does not move; a mismatched skeleton pays the cost and keeps the jump

antiPatterns.dont: leaving skeletons on screen when a request fails
antiPatterns.why: a skeleton that never resolves is indistinguishable from a hung page
